  "rationale": "The user requires Finance approval and reports that Support loses track of ownership across the dashboard-to-email handoff. A timeout also leaves customers at risk of submitting twice. The redesign preserves the approval gate, gives retries the same request ID, and assigns an owner through review and payment recovery. Its verification scenarios cover concurrent retries, failed email, competing decisions, payment uncertainty, accessibility, and an unrelated refund request. The executor observed only `state=blocked` and explicitly left the cause and provider capabilities unresolved. The execution events show only reads, and the fixture snapshots match."
